results.sql: SELECT manufacturer, count FROM top_brands ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT year, avg_price_year AS average_price FROM price_volume_by_year ORDER BY year LIMIT 100
SELECT state, avg_price FROM geo_distribution ORDER BY avg_price DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT condition, count FROM condition_distribution ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT model, SUM(count) AS total_listings FROM prices_by_model_year WHERE manufacturer = 'ford' GROUP BY model ORDER BY total_listings DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT total_vehicles FROM market_stats LIMIT 100
SELECT avg_market_price FROM market_stats LIMIT 100
SELECT oldest_year, newest_year FROM market_stats LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT manufacturer) AS brand_count FROM prices_by_model_year LIMIT 100
SELECT state, count FROM geo_distribution ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT count FROM geo_distribution WHERE state = 'ca' LIMIT 100
SELECT avg_price FROM geo_distribution WHERE state = 'tx' LIMIT 100
SELECT state, count FROM geo_distribution ORDER BY count ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT count AS listings_in_excellent_condition FROM condition_distribution WHERE condition = 'excellent' LIMIT 100
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * cd.count / ms.total_vehicles, 2) AS percent_unknown_condition FROM condition_distribution AS cd JOIN market_stats AS ms ON TRUE WHERE cd.condition = 'unknown' LIMIT 100
SELECT year, SUM(count) AS listings FROM prices_by_model_year GROUP BY year ORDER BY listings DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT avg_price_year AS average_price_2015 FROM price_volume_by_year WHERE year = 2015 LIMIT 100
SELECT SUM(count) AS listings_under_10k FROM price_histogram WHERE price_range < 10000 LIMIT 100
SELECT price_range, count FROM price_histogram ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT year, avg_price FROM prices_by_model_year WHERE manufacturer = 'ford' AND model = 'f-150' AND year >= 2015 ORDER BY year LIMIT 100
SELECT SUM(count) AS total_listings FROM prices_by_model_year WHERE manufacturer = 'honda' AND model = 'civic' LIMIT 100
SELECT AVG(odometer) AS avg_odometer_miles FROM mileage_points WHERE manufacturer = 'honda' AND model = 'civic' LIMIT 100

SELECT mp.model, QUANTILE_CONT(mp.price, 0.5 ORDER BY mp.price) AS median_price, cnt.total_listings FROM mileage_points AS mp JOIN (SELECT model, SUM(count) AS total_listings FROM prices_by_model_year WHERE manufacturer = 'toyota' GROUP BY model) AS cnt USING (model) WHERE cnt.total_listings >= 100 GROUP BY mp.model, cnt.total_listings ORDER BY median_price DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT model) AS distinct_jeep_models FROM prices_by_model_year WHERE manufacturer = 'jeep' LIMIT 100
SELECT year, avg_price FROM prices_by_model_year WHERE manufacturer = 'chevrolet' AND model = 'corvette' ORDER BY avg_price DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT manufacturer, SUM(avg_price * count) / SUM(count) AS avg_price FROM prices_by_model_year GROUP BY manufacturer HAVING SUM(count) >= 1000 ORDER BY avg_price DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT p2020.avg_price - p2010.avg_price AS price_difference_usd FROM prices_by_model_year AS p2020 JOIN prices_by_model_year AS p2010 ON p2020.manufacturer = p2010.manufacturer AND p2020.model = p2010.model WHERE p2020.manufacturer = 'toyota' AND p2020.model = 'camry' AND p2020.year = 2020 AND p2010.year = 2010 LIMIT 100
